reports.notes: Handwritten, crisp. THREE SUMMARY CELLS WERE LEFT BLANK BY THE FILER and are NOT zero: line 1 Column A, line 2 Column A, and line 5 (Subtotal). The filer entered her figures only in Column B (Year-to-Date) yet still filled lines 4 and 6 (which the form draws from Column A) with 581.90 - transcribed exactly as printed, not reconciled. Line 3 is a plain '0'; line 7 is the filer's slashed-zero glyph. The summary page's own 'Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name' and 'Date of Report' header boxes are blank, so report_date is the cover-page signature date. Office naming differs from the portal only by convention (index.csv 'County Commission Seat B' vs the form's 'County Commissioner B') - not a substantive conflict.

contributions.anchor: Schedule A's OWN printed figures — 'Subtotal for this page $581.90' and 'Total Contributions Received $581.90' — corroborated on the p2 Summary Page by line 4, 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A) 581.90', which the form itself declares to be the Column A per-period figure. THE COVER'S line-1 Column A CELL IS BLANK on this filing (a document-level property flagged by the 2026-08-01 cover tranche), so the schedule's own printed total is what gates this side.
contributions.detail: 1 Schedule A entry: 581.90 = the schedule's printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed Total Contributions Received = summary line 4 (which the form instructs the filer to copy 'From Line 1 Column A'). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 581.90 as well and is NOT summed as an increment; because line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' is 0 and this is the filer's only report of the cycle, the period figure and the YTD figure necessarily coincide, so nothing was differenced across filings to reach this. THREE summary cells are genuinely EMPTY and are not zeros: line 1 Column A, line 2 Column A and line 5 (Subtotal). The ladder that IS printed closes: line 3 0 + line 4 581.90, less line 6 581.90, = line 7 (a written zero flanked by dashes = 0).

expenditures.anchor: Schedule B's OWN printed figures — 'Subtotal for this page $581.90' and 'Total Expenditures Received $581.90' — corroborated by p2 summary line 6, 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A) 581.90'. The cover's line-2 Column A cell is BLANK, so the schedule's printed total is the gate.
expenditures.detail: 5 Schedule B rows sum to 519.48 + 24.52 + 21.87 + 10.69 + 5.34 = 581.90 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed schedule total = summary line 6. Column B YTD 581.90 is retained as cumulative and never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed both sides at 581.90; monetary-plus-in-kind was tested and is identical, because no row is marked in-kind and this form prints no in-kind column or line. The single Schedule A entry is headed 'Loan to campaign' by the filer — a LOAN, not an in-kind gift — and is transcribed as the money entry the filer made, not reclassified.
itemized.escalation_note: Three tight cell crops at 900 dpi, all geometry/legibility proofs rather than arithmetic (the arithmetic closed on the printed subtotals first): p3 band 3 rendered '581.90'; p4 band 2 rendered '519.48'; p4 band 6 rendered '5.34'. These also settled a per-filing property: on THIS filing the first written entry sits in the SECOND band (the filer skipped the first ruled line), whereas on the same-family 2008 Ellertson filing the first entry sits in the extrapolated first band — the first-row position is a filer habit and must be crop-proved per page, never assumed.

itemized.notes: legacy_colAB variant on the 2010 blank; 4 pages: p1 cover ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', signed 5/24/10, amendment box marked No, stamped received MAY 24), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed header; its own Page/Last Name/Date of Report header box is left entirely blank, as it is on p3 and p4 — this filer filled in none of the four page headers), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. THE FLAGGED COVER PROPERTY IS CONFIRMED AT THE SOURCE: line 1 Column A, line 2 Column A and line 5 (Subtotal) are genuinely EMPTY CELLS — not zeros, not a failed read — while lines 3 (0), 4 (581.90), 6 (581.90) and 7 (a written zero flanked by dashes, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling) are printed. Both sides therefore reconcile against the SCHEDULES' own printed subtotals/totals (581.90 each), corroborated by summary lines 4 and 6, which the form's own instruction defines as the Column A per-period figures. Neither side is withheld and no figure was synthesized by differencing covers. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'Linda Houskeeper' (Republican, residence city Orem) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row; page-face Office Seeking reads 'County Commissioner B', agreeing with index.csv's 'County Commission Seat B'. CROSS-FILING OBSERVATION, recorded not adjudicated: the same-cycle Assessor filing 3ebf4721 (Steve Hemingway, also of Orem) carries a Schedule B line 'ROOM DONATION - LINDA Houskeper 20.00' dated 4/24/2010; the surname there is compressed handwriting and was transcribed as written. Nothing was joined between the two filings. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — published in the clear by the county; only city was carried from the donor's address block, at READ TIME.
